approvalProcess.rule: A trip page (trip × city) is indexable in production when the owner has approved it (city listed in publishApproved; all previously indexable trip pages are approved) and none of its essential facts is in CONFLICT. Missing facts are flagged NEEDS CONFIRMATION in the ledger and audit but do not block the page. Pending records (status PENDING_APPROVAL, e.g. Travloger-based campsite drafts) are never live.
steps: npm run catalog:audit lists each page as NOT ELIGIBLE (with the missing essential facts) or ELIGIBLE FOR APPROVAL.
The owner reviews an eligible page on staging and approves it.
Add the city to publishApproved for that trip (one page at a time).
PUBLIC_ALLOW_INDEXING=true npm run build && npm run check:all: check:integrity fails if an approved page has unverified essential facts or an unapproved page is indexable.
